blocks.title: Lattice energy (ΔHlatt)
blocks.text: Kisi ionic crystal ki lattice energy woh enthalpy change hai jo tab hoti hai jab gaseous ions se standard conditions par ionic compound ka ek mole banta hai.

blocks.text_alt: Na⁺(g) + Cl⁻(g) → NaCl(s)    ΔH°latt = –787 kJ mol⁻¹

blocks.text: Lattice energy ki miqdar par asar dalne wale factors
Lattice energy in factors par depend karti hai:
Lattice energy aur ions ka size

Figure 6.6 mein alkali metal halides ki lattice energies di gai hain. Data se saaf hai ke cation ya anion ka size barhne se lattice energy kam hoti hai. Ions bare hon to mukhalif charge wale ions ek doosre ke itne qareeb nahi aa sakte, aur un ki packing dheeli hoti jati hai.

blocks.alt: Lattice enthalpy / kJ mol-1 (axis -600 se -1100 tak, 0 tak toota hua) ka graph halide ions F-, Cl-, Br-, I- ke muqable, jo neeche barhte size ke dairon se dikhaye gaye hain. Paanch girti lakeerein, har cation ki ek, aur baen taraf Li+ se Cs+ tak barhte size ke daire. Taqreebi chhape nuqte: Li+ -1043, -845, -801, -751; Na+ -910, -783, -732, -687; K+ -812, -710, -670, -637; Rb+ -768, -682, -644, -615; Cs+ -718, -650, -618, -593.
blocks.caption: Figure 6.6: Alkali metal halides ki lattice energies (kitab ki Figure 6.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har line ek cation (Li⁺, Na⁺, K⁺, Rb⁺, Cs⁺) ki hai, aur neeche F⁻, Cl⁻, Br⁻, I⁻ hain. Daen jayen (anion bara) to value zero ki taraf aati hai, yani lattice energy kam. Neeche ki lines (bare cations) bhi kam lattice energy dikhati hain. Sab se zyada LiF ki hai.
Lattice energy aur ions par charge

Lattice energy ions ke charge ke directly proportional (seedhi nisbat mein) hai: ion par charge jitna zyada, lattice energy utni zyada, aur ulta bhi. Ise samajhne ke liye lithium fluoride (LiF) aur magnesium oxide (MgO) ka muqabla karte hain.
Dono compounds ki lattice mein ions ki tarteeb ek jaisi hai, aur dono mein cations aur anions ke size bhi taqreeban ek jaise hain.
LiF aur MgO mein bara farq ions ke charge ka hai, jo lattice energy par asar dalta hai.
Magnesium oxide ki ΔHlatt [MgO] = –3923 kJ mol⁻¹ hai, jo lithium fluoride ki ΔHlatt [LiF] = –1049 kJ mol⁻¹ se kahin zyada hai.

MgO ke do charge wale Mg²⁺ aur O²⁻ ions ek doosre ko LiF ke ek charge wale (aur usi size ke) ions se zyada zor se khainchte hain. Ek jaise size ke ions mein charge zyada ho to charge density zyada hoti hai, aur ionic bonds zyada mazboot bante hain.
Group II hydroxides aur sulphates ki solubility ke rujhanat (trends)
ΔH°sol lattice energy aur hydration enthalpy dono par depend karti hai.

items: Group II hydroxides: group mein neeche jaate hue cations ki charge density kam hoti hai, is liye hydration energy aur lattice energy dono kam hoti hain. Lekin Mg(OH)₂ se Ba(OH)₂ tak lattice energy Mg²⁺ se Ba²⁺ ki hydration energy se zyada tezi se kam hoti hai. Is liye yahan lattice energy ka asar ghalib (dominant) hai: ΔH°sol zyada exothermic hoti jati hai aur solubility barhti hai.

Group II sulphates: SO₄²⁻ ion OH⁻ se bohat bara hai, is liye MgSO₄ se BaSO₄ tak lattice energy kam ghatti hai, jab ke cation ki hydration energy zyada ghatti hai. Ab hydration energy ka asar ghalib hai: ΔH°sol zyada endothermic hoti jati hai aur solubility MgSO₄ se BaSO₄ tak kam hoti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab sulphate ion ko 'SO₄²⁺' likhti hai; sahi SO₄²⁻ hai. Sulphates wale point ke aakhir mein kitab likhti hai 'more endothermic so solubility increase'; sahi yeh hai ke solubility kam hoti hai (kitab usi point mein pehle khud yahi kehti hai).

blocks.prompt: BaSO₄ MgSO₄ se kam kyun ghulta hai, jab ke Ba(OH)₂ Mg(OH)₂ se zyada ghulta hai?
blocks.explanation: Chhote OH⁻ ke saath group mein neeche lattice energy tezi se girti hai aur hydration kam girti hai, is liye ghulna aasan hota hai aur solubility barhti hai. Bare SO₄²⁻ ke saath lattice energy kam badalti hai, magar cations ki hydration energy tezi se girti hai, is liye solubility kam hoti hai.

items: Lattice energy: gaseous ions se ionic solid ka ek mole (NaCl –787 kJ mol⁻¹).
Bare ions: kam lattice energy; zyada charge: kahin zyada lattice energy (MgO –3923, LiF –1049 kJ mol⁻¹).
Group II: hydroxides neeche zyada ghulte hain (lattice energy ghalib), sulphates kam (hydration energy ghalib).
